description: This file implements the GroqText-to-Speech (TTS) service in Python, providing methods for speech synthesis using Groq's API, including configuration parameters, API client initialization, and a generator method for speech output.

classes.name: GroqTTSService
classes.description: Implementation of a text-to-speech service utilizing Groq's API, supporting configuration of language, speed, and voice options, with methods to generate speech asynchronously.

classes.name: GroqTTSService.InputParams
classes.description: Data model for input parameters such as language and speech speed for the TTS service.

methods.name: bool can_generate_metrics(self)
methods.description: Indicates whether the service supports metrics generation; returns True.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_tts(self, text: str)
methods.description: Asynchronous generator that synthesizes speech from text input and yields audio frames or error frames.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: str, output_format: str = "wav", params: Optional[InputParams] = None, model_name: str = "playai-tts", voice_id: str = "Celeste-PlayAI", sample_rate: Optional[int] = GROQ_SAMPLE_RATE, **kwargs, )
